terra.problem: The claim that priests appear throughout Jeremiah is a Bible fact from outside the passage and needs a supporting reference.
The verse says the beloved was given into the hands of her enemies; it does not establish that none of those enemies were kings.
Roaring against Him is not the opposite of running away, and the text does not say the lion isn't sneaking off.
The text says she roared against the LORD; it does not say she wasn't hiding behind a tree.
The claim that Jeremiah is full of kings is a Bible fact from outside the passage and needs a supporting reference.
The claim that north appears elsewhere in Jeremiah needs a reference to a passage that mentions it.
The claim that fasting appears elsewhere in the Bible needs a supporting reference.
